question: Which of the following cities hosted the inaugural Women's Hockey India League in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ranchi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The inaugural Women's Hockey India League in 2025 was hosted in **Ranchi, Jharkhand.**
 
• The city is known for its **rich sports culture** and has produced several prominent athletes, including cricketer MS Dhoni.
 
• Ranchi has hosted various **national and international sporting events** due to its advanced sports infrastructure.
 
• The event aimed to promote women's hockey in India and provide a platform for young talent to showcase their skills at the national level.
 
• The initiative was part of Hockey India's efforts to **popularize hockey across different regions of the country**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Hockey India League (HIL)**

 
 
• Hockey India League (HIL) is a professional field hockey league in India, organized by Hockey India.
 
• It was established in 2013 with the aim of promoting hockey and offering players competitive opportunities.
 
• The league has both men's and women's divisions, with teams representing different cities.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Women's Hockey in India**
 
 
• Women's hockey has gained significant recognition in recent years, with the Indian team performing well in international tournaments.
 
• Events like the Women's Hockey India League help nurture young talent and inspire more women to take up the sport.
 
 
 
• **Ranchi's Contribution to Sports**
 
 
• Ranchi has been home to several sports facilities, including the Birsa Munda Hockey Stadium, which is one of the largest hockey stadiums in India.
 
• The city has hosted numerous national and international sports events, promoting a strong sports culture in the region.
 
 
 
• **Promotion of Regional Talent**
 
 
• Hosting the league in cities like Ranchi ensures better outreach and encourages local athletes to pursue hockey professionally.
 
• It also helps in identifying and nurturing talent from less urbanized regions of the country.
